name: Olathe - The Miller Cabin
address: 15 Howard St, Green Mountain Falls, CO 80819
short_description: Historic 1936 cabin with backyard creek, newly renovated bathrooms, and dual back decks.
full_description:
This 1936 cabin in quaint Green Mountain Falls can sleep up to 8 guests. Enjoy the outdoors walking along the backyard creek and observing the abundant local wildlife. Escape to the peace and quiet of mountain life with many tourist attractions less than 30 minutes away.

This three bedroom and two bath cabin can sleep up to 8 guests.

The main level features a living room, one bedroom (full-size bed), newly renovated bathroom, and a back deck which spans the width of the cabin itself.

The downstairs level includes a full kitchen (stocked with cooking pans and utensils), a dining area, two bedrooms (one bedroom with queen-size bed, one bedroom with two bunk-beds), newly renovated bathroom, and yet another spectacular back deck with a gas grill.

The property includes WiFi internet, landline telephone, and a Roku-enabled television.

Pet Allergies: The last dog visitor was in 2009 and the carpets have been changed since then. No cats have ever been inside the cabin per the owner's history memory.
